resources.string: Toggle audio and haptic Geiger proximity feedback
Reset probability grid and re-center position

Toggle RF and step calibration drawer
Open offline SigSeeker tactical field guide
Toggle offline dark tactical map overlay
Download offline map tiles for current area

SigSeeker runs 100% offline using internal Wi-Fi RTT, BLE, and IMU sensors. Location and nearby radio permissions are required on Android 13/14+ and GrapheneOS so RSSI and RTT ranging data are not stripped.
